sloka: दर्शने मा कृथाः बुद्धिम् राघवस्य वरानने ।का अस्य शक्तिः इह आगंतुम् अपि सीते मनोरथैः ॥३-५५-२३॥
transliteration: darśane mā kṛthāḥ buddhim rāghavasya varānane ।kā asya śaktiḥ iha āgaṁtum api sīte manorathaiḥ ॥3-55-23॥

translations.english: O lovely Sita, give up the thought of seeing Rama. Where does he possess the power to reach this place even on the mental plane ?
